subject: Queue saturation: mitigation options + customer comms
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Alert: p95 and queue saturation affecting FastCart (region: us-west)

Team,

We started seeing persistent queue saturation on gen-api instances serving FastCart at ~09:05 PST. Symptoms:
- p95 latency jumped from ~250ms -> ~1.8s for 8 token-avg requests.
- Internal queue length on node pool q-gen-8 spiked to ~220 (normal < 40).
- Autoscaler is healthy but backpressure is propagating at the routing layer; requests are delayed before batching.

Initial triage (done):
- Captured perf snapshot and KV cache hit rates (attached perf-snapshot-20261129.json).
- Identified sustained fanout spikes from FastCart's batch endpoint — ~3x their baseline QPS for last 30m.
- No obvious kernel failure; memory footprints stable.

Immediate ask:
1) Can product accept temporary parameter limits (max_tokens, concurrency per client) for the next 2 hours to reduce queueing? Need a decision within 20 minutes.
2) Ops can enable an instance routing rule to prefer slightly older model variants (lower GPU memory) if product ok with minor quality drop.

If we don't act quickly this will continue to impact p99 for other tenants in the same pool.

Attachments: perf-snapshot-20261129.json, qflow-heap-sample.txt

—Karthik
SRE
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Rogers <ben.rogers@fastcart.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Alert: p95 and queue saturation affecting FastCart (region: us-west)

Karthik — thanks for the quick triage.

My priorities: protect availability for all customers and minimize visible quality regressions for FastCart. Proposed immediate steps (please respond if feasible):
- Ops: enforce a temporary per-client concurrency cap of 6 for FastCart for 60 minutes.
- Product: apply a soft max_tokens cap of 128 on gen endpoints for FastCart's account (rollbackable).
- Routing: enable fallback to model-legacy-small variant for 10% of FastCart traffic as a circuit-breaker; route the remainder to primary with throttles.

Marissa — can you weigh in on whether a soft tokens cap + 10% legacy fallback is acceptable? If so I'll loop Ben and schedule a 30-minute sync with FastCart to set expectations.

Jasmine — can you prepare a short customer note (2 bullets + expected timeline) we can send if we flip the caps?

If no objections in 15m I want ops to start the concurrency cap.

—Rishi
Director, Customer Reliability
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Alert: p95 and queue saturation affecting FastCart (region: us-west)

Agree with Rishi's approach. A couple of product notes:
- Soft max_tokens cap at 128: acceptable for an emergency window. We'll signal via API response header X-Redwood-Notice so customers can detect and adjust.
- 10% legacy fallback: fine, but we need to tag outputs so the CS team can track any quality regressions and revert quickly.
- For duration: start with 60 minutes, extend only if telemetry shows improved queue length and p95 reduction.

Also: long-term ask for roadmap — we should have an account-level adaptive throttling feature (priority: medium). I'll add INF backlog item and assign a PM.

Marissa
VP Product
From: Ben Rogers <ben.rogers@fastcart.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: FastCart SRE Team <sre@fastcart.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:55:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Alert: p95 and queue saturation affecting FastCart (region: us-west)

Thanks for the heads-up — we saw elevated fanout after a promotional flow kicked off. We're pausing the promo campaign now which should reduce burst within ~10 minutes.

We accept the soft token cap and the 60-minute limit. Please send the customer note and any headers so our engineering team can adapt. Also happy to join a 20-minute call if that helps coordinate the rollback.

—Ben
Head of Engineering, FastCart
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Ben Rogers <ben.rogers@fastcart.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Summary: agreed mitigations + next steps (FastCart queue saturation)

Folks — quick summary of what we executed and next steps:
1) Executed actions (09:55–10:05):
   - Ops enforced per-client concurrency cap = 6 for FastCart (rollbackable flag set).
   - Product applied soft max_tokens = 128 with X-Redwood-Notice header.
   - Routing enabled model-legacy-small fallback at 10% sampling.
2) Observed impact:
   - Queue length on q-gen-8 reduced from 200+ -> 35 within 22 minutes.
   - p95 for FastCart dropped to ~320ms; cluster-wide p95 improved ~15%.
3) Customer comms: Jasmine drafted a one-paragraph note and I sent it to Ben at 10:10 (Ben acknowledged).
4) Follow-ups (owners):
   - INF-4821 (Karthik): add routing health checks and automated degrade thresholds.
   - Product roadmap (Marissa): add account-adaptive-throttle feature to Q1 planning.
   - CS (Jasmine): monitor FastCart quality metrics for the next 48 hours and report any regressions.

Links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4821, incident runbook: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/ops/incident-runbooks/queue-saturation

I'll leave the temporary caps in place for one more hour; ops please rollback only when telemetry is stable for 30 minutes. Thanks for the quick cross-functional response.

—Rishi
Director, Customer Reliability
